$comment: Credentials that were committed before the audit existed, and are known.
Each entry is the sha256 of the leaked value, so this file records that
a credential is outstanding without recording the credential itself.
A finding whose digest is listed here is a leak that is already known and
is being rotated, so the report says so rather than calling it new.
It is still a failure if it turns up in a commit that could be pushed:

To clear an entry: rotate the credential in the provider's dashboard,
rewrite the history, and delete the line.
